verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs explicitly describe unit tests (fast, in-memory, mocked external calls, using standard test frameworks like Mocha/NUnit), property tests, and integration tests that deploy ephemeral infra separate from production, plus `pulumi preview` to validate changes without applying them. This directly matches the story of writing automated infra tests without touching production. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the testing workflow and more detail on property-test mechanics beyond docs.
